reader.requirement: At --std 85 Procedure Division statements (MOVE, ADD, SUBTRACT, COMPUTE, ...) may store into a sum counter, and the stored value is what the RWCS then accumulates into and presents.
reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/CobolVersion/DialectBehavior in Place.cs ReportSumCounterPlace, RuntimeApi.cs SetSumImage, ReportWriter.SetSumImage, CounterResolver.cs: none on the store path; CobolReport.Edition (ReportWriterEmitter.cs:593) feeds DialectBehaviors for sum size-error printing, group indicate, NEXT GROUP save and CF page groups, none of which is the store
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb882 alters by MOVE only; ADD/SUBTRACT/COMPUTE, a negative value and an alteration after accumulation are not exercised (probed here)

probes.printed: AFTER-ADD CF-E=+010.00; CF-X=+01235 after COMPUTE CF-X = CF-X + 1234 and GENERATE; CF-N=-00003 after SUBTRACT 7; MOVE -99.99 TO CF-E after GENERATE, footing printed ' 99.99-'
probes.expected: each alteration is stored in the counter and is what is accumulated into (+1.5 per GENERATE) and printed at the control footing; negative values kept

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR6  (3.19.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: MOVE, ADD, SUBTRACT and COMPUTE all write the counter through SetSumImage and the RWCS reads the altered value; the path is edition-independent.

refuter.evidence: gr6_decl-001 (--std 85): ADD 100 TO CF-K inside USE BEFORE REPORTING CFK printed +112 and +110 (the alteration made at §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR10c is what step e presents), while the FINAL counter rolled forward at step b before it got +0022 (12+10, not 222), i.e. the 1985 step order is kept. gr6_verbs-001: MULTIPLY 4 BY CF-A -> 12, DIVIDE 5 INTO CF-A -> 2 (truncated), ADD 997 -> 999 with NOT ON SIZE ERROR, SUBTRACT 1000 -> -1, ADD 1 to an 18-digit counter at 999999999999999999 -> ON SIZE ERROR and value kept, INITIALIZE CF-A -> 0, DIVIDE ... GIVING CF-E REMAINDER, COMPUTE CF-E ROUNDED = 10/3 -> 3.33; the TERMINATE footing printed '+000', the 18 nines and '  3.33 '. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.19.4 GR6  (3.19.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR10c  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR10c'.
